summary: Backend tests for HEMELEY cover_photos + custom_categories + strict category validation: 16/17 PASSED (94%). All spec items work: GET /api/vendor/me (auth 200 / no-token 401 / customer-token 403), PATCH /api/vendor/profile/branding (cover_photos 2 valid, 4→400, invalid data-url→400; custom_categories trim+persist, conflict with base→400, >40 chars→400), POST/PUT /api/menus/ strict category validation (custom vendor lowercase→original label 'Pizzas'; INEXISTANT→400; PUT XYZ→400), GET /api/vendors/{id} exposes cover_photos + custom_categories, analytics + PDF export no-regression, DB migration confirmed (0 menus with null category). ONE new blocker found: the entire public_router (routes_public.py) is NEVER registered in server.py, so /api/public/menu/{slug} — the PublicMenuPage endpoint required by the feature — returns 404 for ALL slugs. The two bugs from iteration_13 (JWT secret mismatch, cost_price dropped) appear fixed.

critical.issue: routes_public.public_router is defined but NEVER included in server.py. `grep 'routes_public' /app/backend/server.py` returns 0 hits (only routes_vendor_public is imported/registered). Consequence: the whole PublicMenuPage feature (/menu/:slug on the frontend) cannot fetch data — 404 on every slug. The _serialize_vendor_public helper that exposes cover_photos + custom_categories is unreachable. FIX: in /app/backend/server.py add `from routes_public import public_router` and `api_router.include_router(public_router)`.

action_items: REGISTER public_router in server.py: `from routes_public import public_router` + `api_router.include_router(public_router)`. Without this, PublicMenuPage (/menu/:slug) is entirely broken.

Consider seeding vendeur@hemeley.com vendor with a slug (currently has no slug field) so the QR-code / public menu page can be tested against the hero vendor account. Spec referenced slug 'hemeley-preview' which does not exist in DB.
Prior iteration_13 bugs verified fixed: (a) customer JWT now correctly yields 403 on /api/vendor/me, (b) cost_price no longer dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py only registers vendor_public_router; the public_router (partnership, settings, menu/{slug}, order/{slug}) is orphaned — a full feature surface is dead code in production.

routes_vendor_analytics.py grew to 706 lines with the branding PATCH block; still under the 700 threshold but any further addition should trigger a split (extract branding+profile into routes_vendor_profile.py).

PATCH /vendor/profile/branding validates data URL prefix but not the actual base64 payload integrity — a malformed base64 string prefixed 'data:image' would pass and be persisted (client would crash rendering). Consider basic base64 sanity check.

PATCH /vendor/profile/branding: custom_categories dedup uses case-insensitive key but preserves the FIRST casing seen — good. However there is no limit check on total combined byte size of the vendor doc (3 cover_photos × ~5.5MB = ~16MB) which is near MongoDB's 16MB BSON limit. Consider storing cover_photos in GridFS or as CDN URLs.
_validate_category in routes_menu.py duplicates BASE_CATEGORIES from routes_vendor_analytics.py — extract to a shared constants module.

MenuCreate.category defaults to 'plat' but does not enforce membership at Pydantic level; validation is done only in _validate_category. Consistent, but Pydantic-level validation would give better OpenAPI docs.
